translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Wanang kadun so kot keimin kinim so imi weng sung uta ko.
Kale beta Yesus ayo weng guton bela alam weng kidimin kinim bakoyam nadale kukuyam bom kala ka, sun kuw Got wis sánla bom nadiwo kakan keiyama kudáloliw banim keidin kala.
Aka bako nadale, “abiw dukum mak katam kal kot keimin kinim mak be, aka Got atud fingánoma banim, kinim wanang kidela itamoma banim.
Kale abiw kaw tam uyo wanang kadun mak buyo, uka sun kuw tad kinim be atam nadule, amaneng dudaw, ‘naka nalam luk dudubi kale dakonamawo mew kinim bon dinama be, be atamumo,’
kal budu nade aka sun kuw kuásusulumam kudámamába, kata aka bi adik adik beta aket tet dau bako nadale, ‘naka sák Got atud mak fingánongin banim ade kinim wanang mak kidela itamongin banim keisi,
kata wanang kadun bulayo ki sun kuw nam singsing abu, kale kudáli nade sun kuw nam singsing budu utamomi, kale naka dakomami ulum kanodono kanamusu uyo kanoduko.’ Wakeisano,” Kalesa.
Kale Kamok Yesus ayo bako nadale, “kiba mew kot keimin kinim mafak am weng bakaba bo sák kidilaw bom nadiwade
Got alam wanang kinim iyo sun kuw midiliw so táw so amanlawábiw. Kale Got sun kuw utakun uta ken kale kuyamokaba ade aka kalfong fiaw fiaw bom kukayamokaba bá.
Naka dam weng bakoyamon, Got aka alam wanang kinim iyo sun kuw wabading gong dakáyamokaba, kata Got ami kinim tadon kalokaba, aka tad bakan dim wanang kinim seng aket afano kalesiw ka, kalokabane?”
Fedasi kinim so gawman takis kuámin kinim so imi weng guton sung uta ko.
Kale Yesus ayo weng guton be kudew yak yaknodin kinim nuta kinim kidel kae, kale wanang kinim madik iyo isono yakodiw banim keimaliw im bakoyamsa.
“Kale kinim alew mak tam Got Yol am abem kal, Got weng bakadawumo kale uniw. Kale kinim mak be Fedasi kayak ade mak be gawman takis kuámin kinim.

Kale Fedasi asiki alam tudon kan tod nadale Got bakada bom kudew yak alami tei bom bakama ko. ‘Got kaba, naka ken keiyo, kali uyo mew wananga kinima madik itaw keiduyo masi, yakot wanin bá, sakadinin bá, mafak keimin bá ade naka mew gawman takis kuámin kinim alataw bá,
Kale naka wik makuw am dánámin alew alew uyo imin fale kudá suksukamali ade nam kisol adikum gu nangal kal uyo makuw mak bo kukákamábi.” Kalesa.

Kata gawman takis kuámin kinim ayo un bi yak sikam kaekal tod nadale aka mik dakfo katam fen abid tikin kin modongin banim, fatom keidawu gebom kal geng si nadale bakoda, ‘Got kaba, wol mat so keinamalo, naka ban keimin kinim kala.’ Akeisano,” Kalesa.

Kale nadane Yesus bako, “naka dam bakoyamon kala, mew gawman takis kuámin kinim ata Got ayo bakodaw, kaba nam kin dim kinim kidelo, akano, alam am unsa, kata Fedasi kinim aka Got kin dim kidel keisa ba. Be watawo kaleyo bá, yak kan kinim ata amsun keibi kae, kale alam win kufába namti, Got aka kanaba kinim be dabadák tabid dabadá nadale yak kan kinim ata alam win dabadák akála, be kinim ata win kufádawokaba ko.” Kalesa ko.
Man katiw katiw so Yesus so imi sung uta ko.
Wanang kinim iyo man kuáwi bi imadew tad Yesus dákadáw buduwo, teng maleyam im kinim dákamako kale imadew tade bidiwo, Yesus alam weng kidimin kinim iyo itam nadiwade kanamin báno, kale kanayamiw.

Kata Yesus ayo man katik katik iyo weng duyama maek atamiwe, aka alam weng kidimin kinim bakoyam, “man iyo imadáliw tad natamámino, kiba imtamanin bá kala, watawo kaleyo bá, wanang kinim kan ata kanodin man katiw bidi taw kei bidiw kaí, ika Got ami kasák gu be imi ka.” Kalesa.
“Kale naka dam weng bakoyamon, kan kinim ita man katiw taw kei Got ami kasák gu uyo aket kumamokabiw, á be ika yak unokabiw, á be aket kumamongin banim namti, atin yak unodiw banim ko.”
Kisol kayakim ami sung uta ko.
Yu kayak gebom kinim mak aka Yesus bakodaw, “Kukumin kinim kidel kaba, naka yakno yakno bi nadino Got ami sun kuw biyámin abiw uyo kudulokabina?” Akane,
Yesus asik weng atung fakadu bakodaw, “watawo kaba bakonam Kukumin kinim kidelo nakawe? Kinim kidel so mak be bá, be Got alafin makuw ata kuw kinim kidel.
Kale kaba sawa bo kalam kal, ‘sakadinin bá, kinim angkukámin bá, yakot wanin bá, ibako kin walasino kalin bá, kale be alam kakun kalaw imi weng ki kidi dudew tabamin kala.’” Akane,
beta kinim ayo bakoda, “adikum sawa bulayo ki atin man katiw alom nadino kidi dudew tabe tadanusi.” Kalane,

Yesus aka kinim am weng kidilaw nadale bakodaw, “kaba kukuw makuw mak waktusaw. Kale kalam ufek ufek adikum faku badaw uyo wansiki dusiki si ku nadawade kisol uyo kudew yak wanang kinim win banim kuyamokabaw, beta abid tikin ufek ufek kidel uyo kudokabaw kala. Kaleyo kaba yak be kanabawe tad nam yán abodalo.” Akane,
kinim ayo weng bela kidi nadale aka ufek ufek kayakim kayo aket mafak mafakane,
Yesus ayo atamomo aket mafak mafaka kale nadale bako kala ko. “Kisol kayakim im yak Got kasák gu unum kalin be atin fit biyo be!
Utamin, alataw kale iniman dukum kemal ayo ken sil wol makat tem fit bi netenoma kayo kisol kayakim ayo ken yak Got ami kasák gu unon kaloma be atin fit bi nadano yak unoma ka!” Kala nade
yak weng kidilawiw iyo bako nadiwade, “be kan ata ken kail bá takeikudawomane?” Kaliwade,
Yesus weng atung fakadu bakoyam, “mew ufek ufek adikum kinim nuka ken fák kanodoluw banim, be Got ata kuw ken kanamoma ka.” Kalane,
Bita ayo Yesus bakodaw, “nuka num abiw kayak so ufek ufek yáw man so adikum kadis kudá naduwe kam mul tein tasuw bede.” Akane,
Yesus bakoyam, “naka dam weng bakoyamon, kinim kan ata alam abiw so kadel so nikil fikal so akun alaw so muduw so iyo bakadu imadá nadale Got ami kasák gu aket fukan dá tabesa namti,
alam ufek ufek kudása umi yán uyo atin akamam tamso kudulokaba ade yanol am mak dánokaba kabadák aka sun biyámin kudulokaba.” Kalesa.
Yesus alam fikalokaba sung bakamsa sung uta ko.

Kale Yesus aka alam weng kidimin kinim imadew yak kaek tei nadale aka bakoyam, “nuka tam Yedusalem unuw ko. Kale lum senin kinim imi weng adikum kanodokabuno kale godu bako nadiw Got ami Kinim kanamokabano, kalesiw uyo mewso matam dam abudongin keimu kala.
Kale aka dabadáliw yak fitad kinim imi dim abane, ika atafi bom nadiwade atam li bom, kasuk fadet yak sala bom, malang tuw wako dawkan bom keimsi nadiwade anbidiw fikalokaba,
kata aka am alewbino kei nadale asiki talá tabokaba.” Kalesa.

Kata Yesus alam weng kidimin kinim iyo ami weng bakaba uyo kal keidongin banim keisiw. Watawo kaleyo bá, weng bakaba umi mit uyo kal keidoliwo kale wánuno, kayo ade ika bo yaknámin sung memak bakabane kalsiw ko.
Yesus munin kinim kin mat kin bádawsa umi sung uta ko.
Yesus aka un bi abiw Yedikko mewso kal nadale kaloma kinim kin mat mak leiw kinang tein bom munba ka. Akeisa.
Kale kinim aka kidilomane, wanang kinim seng kuw tiw taw tiw taw tadenebiw ka. Kale nadano aka bakoda. “Bo yaknabiw?” Ako kalano,
ika bakodaw, “Yesus Nasadet kayak tade eibano.” Akiwe,
aka weng dukum kyang bako nadale kala ko, “Yesus kamok Dewit ami kinim mit Man kaba, wol mat so keinamalo!” Akane,

yak kinim geboma dolok mo kábiw iyo yak bon tem aluk keidaw sading kalálo, akei ngadák fuko dawtidiw, kata aka sading kaloma banim, atin wis sálawin weng dukum gán bom nadale kala ko. “Kamok Dewit Mano, kaba wol mat so keinamalo!” Ak bom keimane,
Yesus ayo weng kidilaw tod nadale, “kinim ayo dew nam tadino!” Yakane, ika kinim kin mat ayo dew maek Yesus mewso tadiwe, Yesus aka bakodaw,
“kaba, naka yakno kamominale?” Akane, kinim ayo bakodawa, “Kamokim naka kin bádono kali.” Akane,
Yesus ayo kinim kin mat bakodaw, “kala kaba kin bádalo! Kalam aket afano kalin ta bom kidel kamuda ka.” Akane,
wabising aka kin bá utam nadale Yesus mul tein ká bom nadale Got ken keiyo kal bom keim tabane, adikum wanang kinim kanodin kukuw utamiw ika Got win kufádawsiw ko.
